description: This file contains integration tests for a PDF processing pipeline in a FastAPI application. It includes functions to generate logos and pages, creates a job, uploads assets, triggers analysis, polls status, checks results, and performs batch fixes, all through test client requests.

methods.name: bytes _make_logo(color=(255, 0, 0), size=(80, 40))
methods.description: Creates an image with a colored rectangle and text, returns PNG bytes.

methods.name: bytes _make_page_with_logo(logo_bytes: bytes, canvas=(600, 800), pos=(100, 120))
methods.description: Pastes a logo image onto a blank canvas at a specified position, returns PNG bytes.

methods.name: Path _save_temp(tmpdir: Path, name: str, data: bytes)
methods.description: Saves bytes to a temporary file within a provided directory.

methods.name: test_pdf_detects_and_fixes_all_pages(tmp_path: Path)
methods.description: End-to-end integration test that simulates creating a job, uploading PNG pages, analyzing, and optionally fixing issues.

ctags.name: _save_temp
ctags.pattern: /^def _save_temp(tmpdir: Path, name: str, data: bytes) -> Path:$/
